query:
SELECT EXISTS(
            SELECT 1
            FROM store_purchases sp
            INNER JOIN store_product_items spi ON sp.product_id = spi.product_id
            INNER JOIN pictures p ON p.gallery_id = spi.gallery_id
            WHERE sp.user_id = $1
                AND sp.status = 'completed'
                AND p.id = $2
        ) as "exists!"
